limitations: M25-0106-P1 — Incorrect density Hilbert conjugation changes the principal block and hides an all-parameter translation kernel — Counterevidence: Printed A0 determinant0.12126170473544845 and its characteristic polynomial are internally correct; initial-phase sign change is a constant diagonal conjugation. These do not identify the correct block.

M25-0106-P2 — Printed approximate solution retains a fourth-order residual required to be fifth order — Counterevidence: Existence of a corrected approximation is not refuted; even-mode inversion provides an explicit repair.

M25-0106-P3 — High Sobolev input is not obtained by the printed interpolation and loss bookkeeping — Counterevidence: b1 is freely selectable; strengthening it can make a smaller interpolation weight work. Correct derivative losses can be retained with residual decay.

M25-0106-P4 — Normalized stability lemma has wrong parameter scale and lacks the adapted state-difference bridge — Counterevidence: If c0 meant the first mean or lhs meant the full speed the test is avoided, but those readings change explicit definitions. Application has additional(4.6)–(4.7) structure; (4.26) is not disproved.
Limitations: Conclusions apply only to assigned arXiv v2; the public 2025 publisher preview is not a full journal-version comparison.
Limitations: No assertion that the nonlinear existence theorem is false; demonstrated failures concern its supplied derivation.
Limitations: Neutral-mode repair and a full adapted transport-stability proof were not supplied or certified.

Limitations: The generic-kernel route to the optimal derivative economy in (4.35) leaves one extra derivative; this bounded optimization was not independently closed and is not an asserted extra error.

Limitations: Only the specified portions of the four public primary dependencies were checked. Reference[27], the HTTP403 Love original and integral-table entries were not claimed read; necessary point dynamics were independently proved.
Limitations: Finite numerical corroboration is not interval certification or patch-PDE reproduction; no author code was run.

M25-0106-P1 — Counterevidence: The determinant computation for the printed matrix is internally consistent; it does not verify the corrected operator. A kernel of the proposed inverse is not a nonexistence proof for the nonlinear Euler solutions.
M25-0106-P2 — Counterevidence: Adding the explicitly derived4 epsilon^2 omega_0 Theta_dot g term restores this local cancellation and preserves parity/mean. It does not remove P1's kernel.
M25-0106-P3 — Counterevidence: This is a counterexample to the low/high interpolation inference. It is not asserted to satisfy the nonlinear residual condition P2 or to be an Euler solution.

M25-0106-P4 — Counterevidence: Interpreting c0 as the mean of f0 or replacing c with the full transport speed changes the actual defined statement. The cited Hmidi-Roulley result controls the full coefficient with different hypotheses. The particular application (4.26) has extra structure and is not disproved by this example.

proposition.claim:
The conjugated order-epsilon^2 finite-rank operator supplies an invertible degenerate periodic block outside a discrete parameter set.

The constructed r_epsilon satisfies G(epsilon r_epsilon)=O(epsilon^5).

Every choice satisfying(6.4) closes the inverse high-norm input and induction.

Normalized c satisfies Delta c<=C(Delta c0+epsilon2 Delta rho) with proof c0=0.

repair.content:
Replace r1 by r1+4 epsilon omega0 Theta_dot g, equivalently r_epsilon by r_epsilon+4epsilon^2 omega0 Theta_dot g. D0g=partial_theta g/4 cancels the missing coefficient; all sizes/even modes preserved.

Require b1>L+2(mu1+a2)(R-L)/a2, choose S sufficiently large and use theta=(R-L)/(b1-L). At b1=20000 kappa=8063/3997>2. Retain rho_(s+4tau+5), use high-norm smallness at low s and residual decay at high s. Missing2tau in(6.22) is absorbed by mu2>=4tau+3.
